data.title: Thai ICF 2026 to feature 21 choirs
data.description: The annual Thailand International Choral Festival is set to take place from Monday until Friday at the Thailand Cultural Centre in Bangkok, with performances from 21 Thai and international choirs under this year's theme of "Sabai Sabai".

data.title: Lumpini Park puts smart parking to test
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) will begin testing a new smart parking management system at Lumpini Park in September as part of efforts to ease chronic parking congestion and improve convenience and safety for park visitors.

data.title: Thailand Riviera coastal drive gets tourism push
data.description: Regional authorities are stepping up efforts to promote the Thailand Riviera coastal route as a major tourism corridor, as part of plans to improve public awareness, enhance visitor facilities and spread tourism income to communities along the Gulf of Thailand's western coastline.

data.title: Cabinet backs faster removal of foreigners
data.description: A cabinet-backed draft regulation will allow authorities to remove foreigners whose conduct is deemed incompatible with Thai morals and social norms, Deputy Prime Minister for Legal Affairs Pakorn Nilprapunt said.

data.title: Appetite grows for Talay Noi swamp buffalo meat
data.description: PHATTHALUNG: A research-driven initiative to develop premium meat products from naturally raised swamp buffalo in the Talay Noi wetlands is gaining traction, with demand growing locally and from China.

data.title: Korat business leaders push elevated transit plan
data.description: Business leaders in Nakhon Ratchasima have urged authorities to replace the proposed ground-level Orange Line light rail transit (LRT) project in Muang district with an elevated rubber-tyred electric transit system, saying it would be safer, cheaper and better suited to the province.

data.title: Public Health Ministry launches nursing volunteer scheme
data.description: The Public Health Ministry has launched a new community nursing volunteer programme aimed at strengthening primary healthcare services.

data.title: Sadao crossing upgrades to drive growth
data.description: SONGKHLA: The Sadao Border Checkpoint is again set to handle more than six million travellers this year as authorities seek to expand cross-border trade and improve links with Malaysia, visiting senators said.

data.title: 'Kathu model' a lifesaver for ex-users
data.description: A community-based drug rehabilitation programme in Phuket is helping former drug users rebuild their lives through sustained treatment, family support and employment.

data.title: Super El Niño to arrive in Thailand next year
data.description: Thailand is unlikely to escape the impact of a Super El Niño expected to hit the country in October and last through the early part of the 2027 rainy season, affecting crops, rice plantations and water consumption.

data.title: Tomorrowland fest to rake in B6.13bn
data.description: Thailand expects the inaugural Tomorrowland Thailand music festival in December to attract at least 150,000 visitors and generate an estimated 6.13 billion baht in economic activity.

data.title: Anutin vows justice over murders
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has expressed condolences to the family of two Russian siblings killed in a high-profile murder case and apologised to Russian tourists and the Russian people over the incident.

data.title: Government ready for censure debate
data.description: Government chief whip Korrawee Prissananantakul has dismissed concerns over an expected no-confidence debate when parliament reconvenes, saying the government is ready to answer questions on all issues.

data.title: Bhumjaithai raps iLaw over Senate poll probe
data.description: The Bhumjaithai Party has accused iLaw of applying double standards in its scrutiny of the 2024 Senate election, saying it had overlooked similar conduct by the Progressive Movement.

data.title: Court upholds Thailand’s ban on toxic farm chemicals
data.description: But businesses to be reimbursed for cost of recalls and disposal

data.title: Woman arrested after mother-in-law beheaded in Phuket
data.description: A 36-year-old woman was arrested after her 74-year-old mother-in-law was killed and beheaded following a domestic dispute at a house in Muang district of Phuket on Saturday.

data.title: Rescued wild elephant calf in critical condition
data.description: KANCHANABURI - Veterinarians are closely monitoring a wild elephant calf rescued from starvation after being stranded near a fast-flowing stream in Sai Yok district for two days.

data.title: Missing family of three found buried near Russians
data.description: The arrest of two suspects who confessed to killing two Russian siblings in Chon Buri has led to another tragic discovery involving a Thai family of three who had been reported missing two months ago.

data.title: B50m public health promotional budget questioned
data.description: Former Rural Doctors Society leader, Dr Supat Hasuwannakit, has urged the Public Health Ministry to explain the alleged spending of at least 50 million baht on policy promotion events.

data.title: Centre for ID fraud to tackle bogus registrations, identity theft
data.description: The Department of Provincial Administration (Dopa) has launched a dedicated registration security centre to combat fraudulent civil registration records and identity misuse, as authorities step up efforts against transnational criminal networks exploiting loopholes in Thailand's registration system.

data.title: Thailand seeks to lift investment
data.description: Thailand aims to raise total investment to 30% of GDP to escape the middle-income trap and achieve high-income status within the next 12 years, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.

data.title: Democrats' balancing act
data.description: Abhisit's Section 112 rehabilitation remarks expose risks of pursuing the political centre in an increasingly polarised Thailand v Rival findings on collusion case leave the Election Commission facing a decision that could reshape Thai politics.

data.title: BJT raps iLaw over Senate poll probe
data.description: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) legal affairs chairman Supachai Jaisamut yesterday accused iLaw of applying double standards in its scrutiny of the Senate election, saying it had overlooked similar conduct by the Progressive Movement.

data.title: MP delays appearing for summons
data.description: People's Party (PP) list-MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu postponed appearing before Department of Special Investigation (DSI) investigators on a second summons over an alleged foreign exchange (forex) investment scam, citing parliamentary duties.

data.title: City tuk-tuk ban still pending review
data.description: The Department of Land Transport says reports claiming conventional tuk-tuks will soon be banned from Bangkok's inner districts are premature, stressing the proposal remains at the public consultation stage.

data.title: Supat questions B50m promotions spend
data.description: Former Rural Doctors Society leader, Dr Supat Hasuwannakit, has urged the Public Health Ministry to explain the alleged spending of at least 50 million baht on policy promotion events.

data.title: Regional bloc to sign digital economy pact at summit
data.description: MANILA: Thailand's push for a region-wide digital economy pact has reached a milestone, with the Asean Digital Economy Framework Agreement (Defa) set to be signed by leaders at the 49th Asean Summit in the Philippines this November.

data.title: Unpaid traffic fines now affect vehicle tax renewals
data.description: The Department of Land Transport (DLT) will begin linking unpaid traffic fines to annual vehicle tax renewals starting today.

data.title: Draft bill limits cannabis to medical use
data.description: The Department of Thai Traditional and Alternative Medicine (DTAM) has unveiled a draft cannabis control law that limits use to medical purposes, bans promotion and establishes a national regulatory committee.

data.title: Dopa launches centre for ID fraud
data.description: The Department of Provincial Administration (Dopa) has launched a dedicated registration security centre to combat fraudulent civil registration records and identity misuse, as authorities step up efforts against transnational criminal networks exploiting loopholes in Thailand's registration system.

data.title: Test bureau boss faces 7 criminal charges
data.description: The director of Srinakharinwirot University's Educational and Psychological Test Bureau has acknowledged seven criminal charges in an alleged fraud involving recruitment examinations for local government positions.

data.title: Govt eyes boost to investment
data.description: Thailand aims to raise total investment to 30% of GDP to escape the middle-income trap and achieve high-income status within the next 12 years, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.

data.title: 210,000 appeal welfare card rules
data.description: More than 210,000 people have appealed for an eligibility review under the state welfare card programme following a revision to the vehicle ownership criteria, according to the government.

data.title: 20,000 Cambodians ‘still displaced’ along Thai border
data.description: PHNOM PENH - ⁠More ⁠than 20,000 Cambodian civilians remain ​displaced along the country’s border with Thailand following two rounds of ​fighting between the Southeast Asian neighbours ‌last year, a UN expert said on Friday, following a visit to the disputed frontier.
